CustomField.description: Slack Group(s) that should be notified on L2 escalations (comma separated)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The L2 Slack Group is used for Case Escalations. For example, when a L2 Escalation for this team is raised this group (or groups) will receive a @ slack notification in the corresponding L2 channel. To specify a single group, simply type in the group name, patchsme or specify multiple groups via comma separated values patchsme,smegroupfoo.
CustomField.label: L2 Slack Groups
